newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU free-mkt wheat export bids total 770,050 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: EU free-mkt wheat export bids total 770,050 tonnes.

text.p: European Union exporters submitted bids to export a total of 770,050 tonnes of EU free-market soft wheat at subsidies ranging from 2.97 to 12.99 Ecus per tonne at this week's grain tenders, EU grain industry sources said on Thursday.
Last Thursday the European Union granted the export of 237,470 tonnes of EU free-market soft wheat at a 4.97 Ecus per tonne refund, worth between $173 and $174 per tonne on world markets.
Offers to export EU wheat at subsidies of under five Ecus per tonne involved up to 116,000 tonnes, sources said.
These offers included bids to export 87,000 tonnes of wheat at a 4.87 Ecus refund and 20,000 tonnes of wheat at a 4.97 Ecus per tonne refund. Both offers were made in France.
Sources suggested the EU may grant the export of 87,000 tonnes at the 4.87 Ecus per tonne refund.

National grain office ONIC reported earlier bids in France for 657,750 tonnes of EU wheat at refunds ranging from 4.47 to 12.99 Ecus per tonne. German traders placed bids to export 23,500 tonnes of EU wheat at refunds of between 2.97 and 10.55 Ecus per tonne. There were bids for wheat elsewhere in the European Union.
